manifest.description: GitHub Actions CI runner (ephemeral, shallow clone by default)

quirks.description: Secret mounts via the 9p filesystem may appear unreadable even when the path exists. This is a WSL2 filesystem interaction, not an application bug.
quirks.mitigation: Copy the secret value into the process environment directly rather than relying on file-based mounts under WSL2.

quirks.description: Checkout action produces a shallow clone by default. Full git history is unavailable unless --unshallow is explicitly requested.
quirks.mitigation: Add `fetch-depth: 0` to the checkout step, or run `git fetch --unshallow origin` before any history-dependent command.

quirks.description: The GitHub Actions workspace is ephemeral. Any uncommitted work, locally running containers, or in-memory state from a previous job will not persist.
quirks.mitigation: Treat each job as a fresh environment. Persist artefacts via actions/upload-artifact or external storage.

quirks.description: Azure Container Apps may serve an older revision while a new deployment is in-flight. Health probe results may reflect the previous revision.
quirks.mitigation: Query the active revision list and confirm trafficWeight=100 for the expected revision before running post-deploy checks.
